answer: Vesting time-lock: rewards an agent earns are locked and vest linearly over 60 days, and any unvested balance is burned if the agent is flagged as a sybil. The operator pays in waiting: each fake identity must stay active and pass audits for the whole period, so the capital tied up and the upkeep grow with every clone. No wallet is a safe haven. Survives a ring that farms one epoch and flees into the dune: its rewards are still locked, and a grove of linked accounts loses everything at once.
